source.note: No rank is recorded. His line stands in the day's second paragraph, which carries no icon; the day's one icon, «Совершается служба на шесть», stands before the martyrs Sergius and Bacchus in the first.

attestations.note: The Russian's «(IV)» agrees with the fourth century saint.gr gives, so the folder's `dates` stand as they were. Its index names him «Полихроний, пресвитер, сщмч.», and its life adds what the Greek does not: the vineyard at Constantinople, the church he paid for, a tradition that he sat at the First Ecumenical Council, and Arians as his killers.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 7 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Polihronie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Πολυχρόνιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps. saint.gr calls him «ο Ιερομάρτυρας» and makes him a presbyter of Constantinople killed by Arians at the altar under the emperor Constantius; the corpus's `types` for him are `martyr` and `presbyter`, and the hieromartyr rank the page gives is left for the writer to decide rather than added here. The page states the fourth century, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. A second entry on the same day, «Άγιοι Δέκα συναθλητές του Αγίου Πολυχρονίου», names his ten fellow contenders, who are drafted as ten new folders in batch el-10-07-1.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.10.2026 (7. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Полихроније“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE IDENTIFICATION IS ON THE PROVINCE AND NOT ON THE NAME, which matters here more than on most days: the corpus keeps eleven `*-companion-of-polychronius` folders on this same menologion day, all of them related to this folder, so a Polychronius on 7 October is not self-evidently this Polychronius. The Prologue opens «Родом из епархије Агатанидске», and this folder’s own `dates` note quotes saint.gr’s «ἐκ τῆς ἐπαρχίας Γαμφανήτιδος» while the Romanian life calls it Gamfanita. **The same obscure province, the same peasant father, the same vineyard, the same church built with the wages, the same Council, the same death at the hands of Arians inside a church.** One man, and the row goes on the folder that exists. WHAT IS NEW, AND ONE PIECE OF IT IS A DIFFERENT ACCOUNT RATHER THAN AN ADDITION. The vineyard belongs to **a certain man of Constantinople** («некога Цариграђанина»), where the Russian puts the vineyard itself in the city; the owner gave him **far more money than he had earned**, which is sharper than the Romanian’s sum of gold and the Russian’s great deal of money. And the ordination: **at the time of the Council of Nicaea he was a reader**, чтец, **and it was the zeal he showed there in pleading Orthodoxy against the Arians that got him ordained priest.** The Romanian makes him deacon and then priest after the Council, the Greek has him go up to Constantinople and be made deacon and then presbyter there, and **the Prologue has no diaconate at all and makes Nicaea the cause.** His end is «исекоше га на комаде», they cut him to pieces, against the Greek’s throat cut upon the holy table and the Romanian’s swords at the altar. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND NOTHING HERE COULD HAVE TOUCHED THEM: the folder holds `death` 301–400, 4th century, and **this entry prints no year at all** — Nicaea is its only fixed point and a council is not a date for a death. The appended paragraph carries no four-digit year, deliberately. `types` UNTOUCHED at `martyr`, `presbyter`: муч. in the heading is the `martyr` already there, and **the priesthood is a verb in the body** («посветише га за свештеника»), not a rank word in the heading, so it is no warrant for `presbyter` — which the Russian name page «Полихроний, пресвитер» already was. No `office`: the entry names no see and no house. NO NEW `related` AND NO NEW NAME IN THE PROSE. The entry names the vineyard’s owner not at all, the Council is not a folder, and Аријанци are the adversaries; the eleven companions are already related and this entry does not name one of them. No `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Полихроније», which folds to `полихроније` and not to the `полихронии` of the stored Russian form on this same folder — measured. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.
